blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Outgoing Philippine Economic Zone Authority (Peza) Director General Tereso Panga on Friday bade farewell to the agency following a government reshuffle that would see Joshua Bingcang, president and CEO of the Bases Conversion and Development Authority, take over his post. In a social media post, Panga, who has served Peza for 28 years, including the last three as director general, confirmed his departure.
